author: Nintendo of America YouTube
text:
Pokémon Pokopia – Bubbly Basin Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
The Pokémon Pokopia game is available now, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pokemon-pokopia-switch-2/ 

Part 1 of the Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass paid DLC, Bubbly Basin, is available now! Use the move Dive—an underwater exploration ability added in a free software update to Pokémon Pokopia—to visit the aquatic area of Bubbly Basin. You’ll find additional furniture items, a new outfit for Ditto, and more Pokémon to meet, of course!

To access Bubbly Basin’s underwater gate, you must first learn Dive and complete the important request “Raise the environment level!” in Bleak Beach.

Full version of game required to use DLC. Sold separately unless otherwise noted. Individual DLC parts cannot be purchased separately.

text:
Big Walk – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Play Big Walk now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6005a87lD

From the creators of Untitled Goose Game comes a new co-op online walker-talker! Set out with your friends through an open world full of challenges, puzzles, and discoveries. Work together to find your way around, stay in contact using an assortment of tools and toys, and figure out new ways to communicate when you suddenly find yourself speechless. 

Adventuring aside, there’s plenty of time to just hang out! Sit and watch the sunset or steal your friend’s binoculars and kick them into the ocean. After all, spending time with friends is the best part of a big walk. 

#BigWalk
